capabilities: Export vault notes to reMarkable as typed-text notebooks
Import device documents back as clean markdown, including footnotes
Send PDFs and pull back ink-annotated copies plus extracted text highlights
Check out vault notes until pulled back to prevent divergent copies
Watch for device edits and offer or perform automatic pulls
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual install only. Flagged by Obsidian review tooling for direct filesystem access outside the vault, which the README explains in detail. Beta, tested only on macOS with a reMarkable Paper Pro; Windows/Linux store paths are untested. Plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with reMarkable AS; accepts donations.
problem: There is no supported way to send Obsidian notes to a reMarkable tablet, edit them there, and pull the changes back without the paid Connect subscription or the unofficial cloud API.

relations.evidence: a TypeScript port of rmscene's logic, cross-checked against it on hundreds of real pages
pen rendering calibration follows reMarkable Sync
the official desktop app does all the syncing

requires.name: reMarkable tablet with Type Folio for typed editing

summary: Round-trips notes and PDFs between Obsidian and a reMarkable tablet through the official desktop app's local document store.
